Branding customization includes colors, banners and avatars
Custom domains enable white-labeled booking experiences
Focus protection features include buffers, limits and time blocking
Team scheduling offers collective, round robin and group modes
Users report successful scheduling for hiring and large teams

featureTranslations.plainExplanation: Attendees see their existing events superimposed on your availability grid
featureTranslations.whoCares: People scheduling with busy professionals who juggle multiple commitments
featureTranslations.whenItDoesNotMatter: When scheduling with individuals who maintain empty calendars or prefer manual coordination

featureTranslations.plainExplanation: Distributes meetings automatically among team members
featureTranslations.whoCares: Sales or support teams needing equitable lead distribution
featureTranslations.whenItDoesNotMatter: For individual schedulers or teams with specialized role-based assignments

scoreRationale.onboarding: A guest-friendly week view and calendar overlay appear approachable, but no independent setup evidence was available, supporting 7.7.
scoreRationale.product: Features include visual scheduling, calendar overlay, branding controls, focus protection, and team coordination modes
scoreRationale.support: No independent support accounts were available, so uncertainty limits the score to 6.7.
scoreRationale.billing: A free trial and 30-day money-back guarantee reduce trial risk, while missing current price detail limits the score to 7.0.
scoreRationale.overall: SavvyCal offers thoughtful guest, focus, and team controls, but vendor-led evidence limits the overall score to 7.4.
